items.difficulty_reason: Products of K-injective dg modules are K-injective: for an acyclic K the author writes the dg-level identity Hom(K, prod I_t) = prod Hom(K, I_t) - justified because taking products commutes with the forgetful functor to graded A-modules - and closes with the exactness of products on abelian groups, so factorwise vanishing forces the Hom to vanish. Retained author proof at lines 3978-3992.
